articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Chain
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a unified architecture that natively fuses text, image, audio, and video reasoning within a single chain-of-thought pass. Benchmarks show a 34% improvement on GPQA-Diamond and near-human performance on several doctoral-level science exams, raising questions about evaluation saturation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's RT-4 Enables Robots to Generalize Across Unseen Kitchens in Zero-Shot
articles.summary: DeepMind published results on RT-4, a vision-language-action model trained on 150K hours of demonstration data that achieves 87% task success in previously unseen residential kitchens with no fine-tuning. The system leverages a world-model pre-training stage that predicts physical outcomes before committing to motor plans, significantly reducing failure-recovery loops.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids at BMW Spartanburg Plant
articles.summary: Figure announced its first paid commercial deployment, with 50 Figure 03 humanoid robots performing parts kitting and inspection at BMW's South Carolina facility. The robots operate alongside human workers on mixed assembly lines, each handling roughly 600 pick-and-place cycles per shift with a reported error rate under 0.3%.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers 2.0' to Mitigate Jailbreaks at Inference Time
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new paper and shipped Constitutional Classifiers 2.0, an inference-time safety layer that reduced successful adversarial jailbreak rates from 4.8% to under 0.2% on red-team benchmarks without measurable increases in refusal of benign queries. The approach uses lightweight auxiliary models trained via constitutional AI principles to score and intercept harmful reasoning chains mid-generation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process has entered risk production at Fab 20 in Hsinchu, roughly one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, promising a 12% speed gain and 25% power reduction over N2, with volume production targeted for late 2027.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Open Weights, Surpassing GPT-4.5 on Code and Math
articles.summary: Meta made Llama 4 Behemoth, its largest model at roughly 2 trillion parameters in a mixture-of-experts configuration, available under a permissive open-weights license. Independent evaluations show it outperforming GPT-4.5 on HumanEval+, SWE-bench Verified, and MATH-500, intensifying the debate over whether frontier capabilities can remain proprietary.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Implant with 4,096-Electrode Array
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink de novo clearance for its N2 brain-computer interface featuring a 4,096-electrode array, quadruple the channel count of its first-generation device. Early clinical data from the ongoing PRIME trial show participants achieving cursor control latencies under 100ms and free-form typing speeds exceeding 30 words per minute, a major step toward restoring communication for people with paralysis.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Electric for Warehouse Logistics with 20-Hour Runtime
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics and parent company Hyundai revealed the production-ready Atlas Electric humanoid, featuring a swappable solid-state battery pack enabling a 20-hour continuous operational cycle. The robot targets warehouse logistics with autonomous pallet loading and can handle payloads up to 30 kg, with pilot deployments beginning at Hyundai Mobis distribution centers in Q4 2026.
